c.v: coprocessor is designed as a simplified, low-power replacement of the CPU in sleep modes.
It can also be used to supplement the functions of the CPU in normal working mode.
The ULP coprocessor and RTC memory remain powered up during Deep-sleep mode.
The clock of the coprocessors is the internal fast RC oscillator.
Additional facts from the datasheet (not repeated in the sections below):
ULP-RISC-V: supports the RV32IMC instruction set, thirty-two
It is booted by the CPU, its dedicated timer, or RTC GPIO.
ULP-FSM: supports common instructions including arithmetic, jump, and program control instructions, and on-board sensor measurement instructions.
It is booted by the CPU, its dedicated timer, or RTC GPIO.
The two coprocessors cannot work simultaneously.
